[M157] [ContextualTasks] Bridge external search ports

Original change's description:
> [ContextualTasks] Bridge external search ports
>
> Previously, the AIM page exchanged search messages with the browser by
> posting `window.postMessage` events to embedded extension iframes, which
> failed whenever no extension iframe was mounted in the document.
> Handling external `chrome-search-channel` port connections in the
> component extension's service worker (`background.ts`) and forwarding
> traffic over Mojo keyed by `port.sender.documentId` enables direct
> bidirectional search messaging between the AIM page and the browser.
>
> When a document reconnects with a new port before its previous port
> closes, the service worker ignores stale `onDisconnect` events from the
> superseded port so the active document connection is not dropped.
>

[M157] [Contextual Tasks] Test Super G Page Info bubble

Original change's description:
> [Contextual Tasks] Test Super G Page Info bubble
>
> Adds an interactive UI test covering the Super G logo button in the
> side panel rearchitecture toolbar for Contextual Tasks across all user
> variations (signed-in, signed-out, and incognito). The only existing
> coverage clicked Super G as a step of an extensions flow; this test
> checks that Page Info opens for the panel's page and stays anchored
> inside the side panel.
>
> This tests the following CUJ:
>  (1) User opens Lens Overlay from the 3-dot App Menu on a web page.
>  (2) User types a query into the Lens Overlay Contextual Searchbox and
>      presses Enter to submit.
>  (3) The Contextual Tasks side panel opens on an AI Mode page.
>  (4) User clicks the Super G logo button in the side panel toolbar.
>  (5) The Page Info bubble opens anchored to the Super G button inside
>      the side panel with a TOP_LEFT arrow.
>  (6) The Page Info bubble shows the URL and site of the page in the
>      side panel, not the page in the active tab.
>
> Key Implementation Details:
> - User Variations: Parameterized via
>   ContextualTasksInteractiveTestBaseT<UserVariation> across kSignedIn,
>   kSignedOut, and kIncognito.
> - Assertions: Page Info is tracked for the panel WebContents (not the
>   active tab), its site URL is the side panel's URL rather than the
>   tab's, its header shows the side panel's site (google.com), the
>   bubble arrow is TOP_LEFT, and its anchor rect overlaps the Super G
>   tracked element and lies inside the side panel.
> - Refactor: The Contextual Searchbox query and toolbar instrumentation
>   steps move into fixture helpers shared with
>   AiPageUpdatesThreadTitleAndShowsThreadHistoryInMenu, which also
>   gains its missing CUJ header.
> - Anti-Flakiness: Side panel animations are disabled by the fixture,
>   and the click waits for the Super G tracked element to show and for
>   the button to have a visible layout box.

> Verification:

> - Swarm: 150/150 passes (10 shards x 5 repeats x 3 variations) via

[M157] [Contextual Tasks] Re-enable tab chip test

Original change's description:
> [Contextual Tasks] Re-enable tab chip test
>
> `AddAndRemoveTabFromComposebox` was disabled across Linux, ChromeOS, and
> Windows ASan due to race conditions during side panel zero-state
> initialization and context menu interaction. Attaching a tab before the
> embedded thread frame finished loading raced with `forceComposeboxFocus`
> clearing manual attachments, and slow Mojo IPCs or window blur events on
> instrumented bots could cause the context menu to open before tab
> suggestions rendered or close mid-sequence before clicks settled.
>
> Wait for the inner thread `WebContents` to load before interacting with
> the composebox, ensure context menu helpers wait for tab suggestions to
> render and selection state (`aria-checked`) or menu closure to settle
> with automatic reopen on blur, and re-enable the test on all platforms.

[M157] [context-input] Fix flaky tab context submission across extension frames

Original change's description:
> [context-input] Fix flaky tab context submission across extension frames
>
> Previously, `ContextualTasksWebContentsUserData` marked all registered
> extension frames as handshake-complete at once and always dispatched
> outbound Search messages via `extension_frames_[0]`. When multiple
> extension frames coexisted (such as `context_library.html` mounting
> while `tab_picker.html` was closing, or `tab_picker.html` opening and
> closing on top of `context_library.html`), outbound messages or
> handshake pings could leave Search's `activeChromeWindow` pointing to a
> detached `tab_picker.html` window, causing `OnSubmitQueryRequest` to
> time out after 10s.
>
> Track handshake completion per frame, route outbound messages via the
> most recent active handshake-complete frame, and re-send
> `OnContextStateChanged` through a surviving bound frame when another
> bound frame unregisters.
>

[M157] [WebApk] Make install detection scope-aware for same-origin PWAs

Original change's description:
> [WebApk] Make install detection scope-aware for same-origin PWAs
>
> Since crrev.com/c/8257064 (M154), WebappRegistry.isAppInstalledForUrl()
> decides whether a WebAPK is installed for the current tab by comparing
> origins only (hasAtLeastOneWebApkForOrigin). Origin.create() discards
> the scope path, so once any WebAPK is installed on an origin, every
> same-origin URL is reported as "installed".
>
> The launch side (OpenInApp intent resolution, findWebApkWithManifestId,
> WebApkValidator.queryFirstWebApkPackage) is scope-aware. As a result,
> with PWA A (scope /apps/pwa-a/) installed, visiting PWA B
> (scope /apps/pwa-b/) on the same origin shows "This app is already
> installed" in the Universal Install sheet, and tapping Open fails with
> "Could not open app" because no WebAPK actually covers that URL. The
> omnibox install button (desktop form factor) is hidden for B for the
> same reason.
>
> Prior to crrev.com/c/8257064, install detection used PackageManager URL
> resolution against the WebAPK intent filter (pathPrefix = scope path),
> which was scope-granular. This CL restores that contract without the
> per-navigation PackageManager IPC: isAppInstalledForUrl() now matches a WebAPK only if the URL is within its stored scope, using the same
> UrlUtilities.isUrlWithinScope() predicate that WebApkVerifier and
> WebApkReparentingHandler already rely on. The TWA check is unchanged.
>
> To ensure stored scopes and manifest-ID lookups stay accurate across
> updates and uninstalls:
> - WebappDataStorage.updateFromWebappIntentDataProvider() now updates
>   KEY_SCOPE whenever info.scopeUrl() changes (rather than only when
>   KEY_SCOPE is URL_INVALID), so WebAPK manifest scope updates take
>   effect on relaunch.
> - WebappRegistry.findWebApkWithManifestId() now filters out mStorages
>   entries that are marked uninstalled or no longer installed in
>   PackageManager, preventing an uninstalled child-scope WebAPK from
>   shadowing an installed parent-scope WebAPK when opening the app.
>
> hasAtLeastOneWebApkForOrigin() and getOriginsWithInstalledApp() are
> intentionally left as-is; their remaining callers (ShortcutHelper via
> JNI, site settings) ask origin-level questions.
>
> Also adds test coverage for the changes to WebappDataStorage and
> WebappRegistry as requested.

[M157] Prevent cross-frame selection on GestureLongPress

Original change's description:
> Prevent cross-frame selection on GestureLongPress
>
> When an event handler for `gesturelongpress` mutates the DOM (e.g.
> removing an overlay element above an `<iframe>`), the subsequent hit
> test in GestureManager::HandleGestureLongPress() could descend into a
> child frame and set a cross-document selection on the parent frame's
> FrameSelection.
>
> * gesture_manager.cc: Use event_handling_util::HitTestResultInFrame()
>   instead of EventHandler::HitTestResultAtLocation() in
>   GestureManager::HandleGestureLongPress() so the re-hit-test stays
>   within the handling frame and does not descend into child frames.
>   This is the main fix of the issue.
>
> * web_view_test.cc: Update WebViewTest.LongPressLink to long-press at
>   (499, 299) on the link inside the 500x300 viewport instead of
>   out-of-bounds at (500, 300). This test worked by accident because
>   HitTestResultAtLocation() doesn't have viewport bounds check.
>
> * selection_controller.cc: Verify in `SelectionController::
>   UpdateSelectionForMouseDownDispatchingSelectStart()` that
>   `target_node` and `selection` belong to GetDocument() before and
>   after dispatching `selectstart`, matching
>   UpdateSelectionForMouseDrag().
>   This is an optional change for defence-in-depth.
>
> * selection_template.cc: Upgrade DCHECK_EQ() to CHECK_EQ() in
>   SelectionTemplate::AssertValidFor() to prevent setting a selection
>   whose document does not match the FrameSelection's document.
>   This is another optional change for defence-in-depth.
>
